description.value:
As an action, you can gain the following benefits for 1 minute:

  • Advantage on Constitution saving throws.
  • At the start of each of your turns, temporary hit points equal to your Constitution modifier (minimum 1).
  • When you use Hunting Party against your Ranger's Quarry target, the ally striking gains bonus damage equal to your Ranger's Quarry damage die.

Once used, you must finish a short or long rest before using this feature again.
